components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number

## Change: optional `email` on owners

An owner may now include `email`. When present it must be a syntactically valid address; it's stored and returned lower-cased. When present but invalid, the create request is rejected with 400.

### Files touched (6)

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added an optional `email` string property to the `OwnerFields` schema, so the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto` carry the field (and MapStruct maps it by name automatically — no mapper change needed).

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — added an `email` column field with a plain getter/setter (each CC 1), no logic in existing methods.

3. **`db/hsqldb/schema.sql`** — added the `email VARCHAR(255)` column (nullable) to the `owners` table.

4. **`db/hsqldb/data.sql`** — appended `, NULL` to the ten positional seed inserts, which otherwise mismatch the new column count.

5. **`function/owner/NormalizeOwnerEmail.java`** *(new)* — a single small step, mirroring the existing `NormalizeOwnerTelephone`: leaves a missing/blank value alone, rejects an invalid one with 400 via the existing `MissingOwnerFieldsException`, and lower-cases a valid one in place.

6. **`officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`** — inserted the `normalizeEmail` step into the pipeline between `normalizeTelephone` and `rejectDuplicateTelephone`.

### Keeping structural impact low
- No existing method body was edited — behaviour was added as a new cohesive one-method class (`NormalizeOwnerEmail`, WMC_other = 0) plus trivial CC-1 accessors, rather than growing `BuildOwner`/`ApplyOwner`.
- Reused the existing `MissingOwnerFieldsException` + handler for the 400 instead of adding a new exception/handler/escalation trio (saving 3 files and their functions).
- Scoped persistence to the test DB profile (hsqldb); the default h2 app profile uses `ddl-auto=update`, so it picks the column up automatically.

Tests: `Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — **BUILD SUCCESS**.
